# Authored bookmark metadata

The fixture follows the metadata fields produced by Mindcap
`ce5f709990e82f6e8bd14fe128fa2608c6a1d05b`'s Chrome normalizer/parser. It is an
authored subset for the private cleanup adapter, not a captured/verified bundle.
All titles, IDs, folders, URLs and credential-like strings are synthetic. The
comparison catalog is a local exact-URL fixture, not an Akashic resource index.
